verbalization: Myricetin-3-O-Beta-D-Glucuronide appears to interact with Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP through a multi-step pathway. The evidence suggests that this compound targets Phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase type 2-beta, which is known to be a target of THIOPHENE-2,5-DISULFONIC ACID 2-AMIDE-5-(4-METHYL-BENZYLAMIDE). This second compound, in turn, is implicated in the regulation of Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP. Thus, the relationship between Myricetin-3-O-Beta-D-Glucuronide and Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP is mediated through Phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase type 2-beta, which acts as a bridge in this interaction. The evidence supports a mechanistic link where Myricetin-3-O-Beta-D-Glucuronide indirectly influences the activity of Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP via its effect on the upstream kinase.
